summary: On May 18, 2026, Carbon Revolution plc announced via Form 6-K that its wholly owned Australian subsidiaries (Carbon Revolution Pty Ltd and Operations Pty Ltd) have emerged from Voluntary Administration in Australia under a Restructuring Support Agreement with senior secured lenders that recapitalized the Australian business. The administrators recommended and creditors approved the recapitalization; as a result, the issuer no longer holds any equity interest in those subsidiaries. A process for the orderly wind-down and liquidation of Carbon Revolution plc under Irish law will commence shortly. This filing details a restructuring and subsequent liquidation, not a routine corporate update.
